question: Now that Schult-chan has become the lord of the Barielle domain under the name Schult Barielle, I'd like to know whether he'll grow up without training his body as Lady Priscilla instructed, or whether he'll grow up all muscular by following the methods Heinkel taught him.
answer:
He might not become all muscular, but I do feel that he needs to have a certain degree of strength. Schult-chan should have a very strong sense that he needs to become a person worthy of being the lord of the Barielle domain, so he should steadily grow into a solid, dependable man who won't bring shame to the name “Schult Barielle.”

Right now, I think Garfiel and Schult are about the only two who are properly following the path toward becoming truly good men, so he should continue to grow properly. Though, I don't think he'll become all muscular.
